title: Expert, säkerhetsteknik och dess förutsättningsteknik
description:
Om Kriminalvården

Kriminalvården växer – vi bygger nytt, bygger om och bygger till och söker nu fler medarbetare. Vårt viktigaste mål är att minska återfall i brott – att bryta den onda cirkeln. Lyckas vi med det blir samhället tryggare och säkrare för alla. Vi är den myndighet som ansvarar för anstalter, frivård, häkten och klienttransporter.

Tjänsten är placerad inom sektionen för teknisk säkerhet på Kriminalvårdens säkerhetsavdelning. Sektionen för teknisk säkerhet ansvarar för normering, kravställning, utveckling och förvaltning av myndighetens tekniska säkerhetslösningar, inom säkerhetssystem, kontraband och brandskydd samt sambandsansvar och kriskommunikation via Rakel. Genom enhetliga krav, standarder och långsiktig utveckling säkerställer sektionen robusta, ändamålsenliga och verksamhetsanpassade säkerhetslösningar som stödjer myndighetens uppdrag.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Kriminalvården står inför en stor utmaning med kraftigt utökade byggnationer de kommande åren. Krav på säkerhetstekniska lösningar som inte är kostnadsdrivande men samtidigt effektiva är en central och viktig uppgift. Det är en stor utmaning men också en stor möjlighet att vara delaktig i utformningen av Kriminalvårdens utveckling av teknisk säkerhet och säkerhetstekniska system. I din roll som expert på sektionen kommer du delta i utvecklingsarbetet av teknisk säkerhetsteknik samt dess koppling till IT inom myndigheten. I din roll kommer du huvudsakligen att normera och kravställa säkerhetsteknik, bedriva standardiseringsarbete, utredningsarbete samt arbete med utveckling av säkerhetstekniska lösningar. Du kommer även att hantera och skriva remissvar inom det säkerhetstekniska området samt representera säkerhetsavdelningen i frågor som rör säkerhetsteknik, samverka med IT-avdelningen och fastighetsavdelningen.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som planerar, organiserar och prioriterar arbetet på ett effektivt sätt och som tar ansvar för sin uppgift. Du kommunicerar på ett tydligt sätt och säkerställer att budskap når fram. Som person arbetar du mot mål och fokuserar på resultat. Du styrs av mål- och resultattänkande i prioriteringar, planering och agerande. Vidare tänker du strategisk och har ett brett perspektiv på frågor.

För oss är det viktigt att du delar Kriminalvårdens grundläggande värderingar om en human människosyn, respekt för individen samt tron på människans vilja och förmåga att utvecklas. Du är även medveten om och har förståelse för hur bakgrund, kultur och grupptillhörighet påverkar dig själv och andra. Vidare förväntas du med ditt förhållningssätt bidra till att alla blir likvärdigt bemötta. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Akademisk utbildning inom teknik alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som Kriminalvården bedömer relevant
  • Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete med säkerhetstekniska produkter och deras koppling till IT
  • Erfarenhet av PSIM-system, samtalssystem, passersystem och vms-system
  • Erfarenhet av att utforma långsiktiga och strategiska planer gällande säkerhetssystem samt skriva och uppdatera dokumentation för detta
  • Erfarenhet av att starta och leda utvärderingar av produktersättningar inom området säkerhetsteknik
  • God förmåga att förstå teknisk dokumentation på svenska och engelska
  • God förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska
  • Körkort med lägst behörighet B

Det är även meriterande med:

  • Fortbildning inom det säkerhetstekniska området
  • Erfarenhet inom virtualisering och lagring
  • Erfarenhet av Vmware och Microsoft windows
  • Erfarenhet av administration/konfiguration av överordnade larm- och passersystem
  • Erfarenhet av administration/konfiguration av vms-system
  • Erfarenhet av routing/switching och brandväggsfunktionalitet
  • Erfarenhet av att upprätta och underhålla kravställande dokument till byggnationer och upphandlingsunderlag
  • Erfarenhet av Kriminalvårdens verksamhet

För att bli aktuell för anställning inom Kriminalvården krävs att du motsvarar högt ställda krav gällande lämplighet, omdöme, säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetande och att du följer gällande lagar. Det innebär att du står upp för demokratiska värderingar och den statliga värdegrund som gäller för Kriminalvårdens verksamhet.

title: CRATING CLERK
description:
Summary

This position is responsible for preparing, packaging, and securing finished parts for industrial blanchers and fryers for shipment, ensuring products are protected during transit and arrive in excellent condition. The Crating Clerk will assemble crates, apply appropriate padding and support, coordinate with production and shipping teams to meet delivery schedules, operate hand tools and forklifts safely, maintain accurate inventory and shipping records in the ERP system, and collaborate with production and shipping teams to prioritize tasks. This role also involves inspecting finished products for damage prior to crating, maintaining a clean and safe work area, adhering to company standards and safety protocols throughout the packaging process, labeling, documenting and assisting with the loading of crates while maintaining a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assemble wooden or metal crates according to product specifications and shipping requirements.
  • Secure industrial parts for blanchers and fryers using padding, supports, straps, and other protective materials.
  • Inspect products for damage or defects before crating to ensure quality standards.
  • Collaborate with production and shipping teams to schedule and prioritize crating tasks.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area in compliance with company safety protocols.
  • Operate hand tools, power tools, and material-handling equipment safely and efficiently.
  • Label and document crates accurately for shipping and inventory tracking.
  • Report any issues, damages, or discrepancies to supervisors promptly.
  • Assist in loading crates onto trucks or shipping containers when necessary.
  • Follow company guidelines for packaging, handling, and transport of heavy or fragile equipment.
  • Perform computer-based tasks, including reviewing job records in the ERP system to verify accuracy and confirm all required parts are included.
  • Operate a forklift to safely move, stage, and handle materials in accordance with company procedures.
  • Scan parts into the Ready-to-Ship (RTS) location to ensure accurate inventory tracking.
  • Generate and print packing slips and related shipping documentation to support outbound order processing.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Expectations

title: System Access Administrator
description:
Aviso:

At Aviso, we are dedicated to improving the financial well-being of Canadians. As a leading wealth management organization, we are committed to leadership, innovation, partnership, responsibility, and community. Working with talented and energetic professionals who exemplify our values every day, you will quickly notice that our people and dynamic ‘oneaviso’ culture sets us apart. If you are looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, find out more about what Aviso has to offer at www.aviso.ca.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking to fill an opening for a Systems Access Administrator to join our Information Technology team.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Technology Support Services, the Systems Access Administrator is responsible for providing access to our Broadridge/Dataphile system to our external partners and Aviso employees. The Systems Access Administrator will provide prompt and efficient service to our partners and internal staff.

As oneaviso:

  • We Care – You do the right thing for clients, partners and colleagues. You build trusted relationships, champion service excellence, and contribute to a culture where people feel valued and supported
  • We Dare –You challenge the status quo with bold ideas and fresh perspectives. You embrace change, seek opportunities to innovate and are comfortable exploring new ways of working
  • We Share – You collaborate openly and build meaningful relationships. You seek out diverse perspectives, share your knowledge and work together to help colleagues, clients and partners succeed
  • We Deliver – You take ownership of your work, honour your commitments and focus on delivering meaningful results. You hold yourself accountable and continuously look for ways to improve

What your day looks like:

  • Provision, modify, and revoke user access across enterprise systems, applications, and platforms based on approved requests
  • Administer user access provisioning, de-provisioning, and role-based access controls (RBAC) across systems and applications
  • Maintain and enforce access management policies, standards, and procedures
  • Support periodic user access reviews and attestations (privileged and non-privileged access)
  • Monitor and audit access logs and user activity to ensure compliance with internal and external regulations
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence for access requests and approvals
  • Collaborate with IT, HR, and business units to ensure timely and accurate access changes
  • Manage escalations for high-priority or high-profile access requests
  • Meet defined SLAs and operational KPIs for access fulfillment
  • Troubleshoot access-related issues and provide support to end-users
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of IAM processes, workflows, and documentation
  • Assist in the implementation of automation and self-service capabilities for access requests
  • Document processes and maintain access control documentation
  • Stay current with industry trends and best practices in identity and access management (IAM)

Requirements

Your experience and skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in computer science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 3+ years of experience in system access administration, IAM, or IT operations
  • Experience supporting access management in a regulated or enterprise environment
  • Strong understanding of RBAC, least privilege, and segregation of duties principles
  • Familiarity with Active Directory / Azure AD / LDAP (user and group management)
  • Experience with IAM tools (e.g., SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, Okta, Entra ID)
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, GDPR, HIPAA)
  • Experience supporting high-profile or business-critical applications
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience with Broadridge/Dataphile required
  • Experience of supporting key client accounts
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Strong attention to detail, problem solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team
  • Strong commitment to customer service
  • Fluency (written and spoken) in English is required and bilingual skills in French are an asset
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and ServiceNow is preferred
  • IAM certifications are an asset

Benefits

Why Aviso?

At Aviso, you will find a dynamic and inclusive culture that rewards innovation and celebrates success.
Here are a few things that set us apart:

  • Competitive compensation package that rewards and recognizes individual contributions
  • Excellent health, dental and insurance benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees
  • Generous vacation time, fitness benefit, parental leave top-up options
  • Matching contributions to our retirement program
  • Commitment to the continuous improvement of our staff through learning & development and an education assistance program
  • Regular social events to foster teamwork

Your Information

By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your provided personal information for the purposes of assessing your qualifications and suitability for employment with Aviso. Your information will be handled in accordance with applicable Canadian privacy laws, including the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and relevant provincial legislation. Your data may be shared with authorized personnel involved in the recruitment process and retained only as long as necessary to fulfill these purposes or as required by law.

Further information is available on the Privacy link on our Career Page – Privacy Policies

Equal Employment Opportunity

Aviso welcomes and encourages applications from all qualified individuals including persons with disabilities. If you require an accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs in all stages of the hiring process.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

No recruiters or agencies, please.

Company Overview:

Aviso is a leading wealth management and investment services provider for the Canadian financial industry, with approximately $145 billion in total assets under administration and management, and over 1,000 employees. We’re building a comprehensive, technology-enabled, client-centric wealth services ecosystem. Our clients include our partners, advisors, and investors. We’re a trusted partner for nearly all credit unions across Canada, in addition to a wide range of portfolio managers, investment dealers, insurance and trust companies, and introducing brokers. Our partners depend on Aviso for specific solutions that give them a competitive edge in a rapidly evolving, highly competitive industry. Our investment dealer and mutual fund dealer and our insurance services support thousands of investment advisors. Our asset manager, NEI Investments, specializes in investing responsibly. Our online brokerage, Qtrade Direct Investing®, empowers self-directed investors, and our fully automated investing service, Qtrade Guided Portfolios®, serves investors who prefer a hands-off approach. Aviso Correspondent Partners provides custodial and carrying broker services to a wide range of firms. We have offices in Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, and Winnipeg. Aviso is backed by the collective strength of our owners: the credit union Centrals, Co-operators/CUMIS, and Desjardins. We’re proud to power businesses that empower investors.

A career with Aviso means being part of a group of talented, energetic professionals who live their values every day, and belonging to an organization dedicated to your success and career development. If you’re looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, apply to join our team.

Salary

This position is posted with an expected salary range of $55,000 - $65,000 CAD annually. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate and the requirements of the position.

title: Media Production Specialist
description:
At Improveit Home Remodeling, we are driven by a relentless commitment to growth, innovation, and delivering exceptional experiences for both our team members and valued customers. As an award-winning leader in the home remodeling industry, we are passionate about transforming homes while fostering a dynamic, results-driven culture that empowers leaders to grow.

Position Summary

Improveit Home Remodeling is seeking an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Marketing Operations Coordinator to support the execution of marketing initiatives that strengthen our brand and improve operational efficiency across the marketing department. Position Summary

We are seeking a creative, driven, and highly collaborative Media Production Specialist to bring the Improveit brand to life through photography, videography, storytelling, and social content.

This role will assist in the process of identifying compelling remodeling projects, coordinating with homeowners, capturing professional photo and video content, and transforming that content into engaging assets for social media, digital advertising, commercials, recruiting, and other marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable behind the camera, in the editing suite, and in the field. This person should have a strong creative eye, understand how to tell compelling stories, and be able to independently manage projects from concept through final delivery.
This role will also support select events and on-location marketing activities, including live social coverage and event setup.

Key Responsibilities

Photography & Videography
  • Identify completed remodeling projects and customer stories that are strong candidates for photography and video.
  • Coordinate with homeowners to obtain permissions and schedule photo/video sessions.
  • Capture high-quality photography and video showcasing Improveit’s remodeling work, people, culture, and customer experience.
  • Conduct customer interviews and guide homeowners, employees, and other talent to create authentic, engaging stories.
  • Operate cameras, lighting, audio, and other production equipment professionally.
  • Develop storyboards, shot lists, and creative concepts for video projects.
  • Travel to project sites and event locations throughout Improveit’s markets.
Video & Photo Production
  • Edit and produce high-quality photo and video content using Adobe Creative Suite, including Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and Lightroom.

  • Optimize video and photo assets for different platforms, placements, and formats.
  • Perform photo retouching, color correction, audio editing, and other post-production work as needed.
  • Manage and organize raw footage, photography, project files, and final assets to ensure content is accessible and efficiently maintained.
  • Maintain consistency with Improveit brand standards and creative direction.
Content & Marketing Support
  • Partner with the Marketing team to develop visual content that supports broader marketing campaigns and business objectives.
  • Help identify opportunities to repurpose existing photo and video assets across multiple channels.
  • Collaborate with social media and content team members to develop engaging content.
  • Support the Recruiting team with visual campaigns and content designed to attract top talent.
  • Participate in on-location events and provide live social media content when needed.
  • Assist with event setup, packing/unpacking, display organization, and other marketing logistics as needed.
Project Ownership
  • Manage multiple production projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and priorities.
  • Take ownership of projects from concept and planning through production, editing, and final delivery.
  • Communicate proactively with homeowners, internal stakeholders, and members of the Marketing team.
  • Be receptive to feedback and continuously look for ways to improve the quality and effectiveness of our creative work.
  • Bring new ideas, trends, and creative approaches that help Improveit stand out.
Qualifications & Experience
  • 2+ years of professional experience in photography, videography, media production, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating photography and video production skills.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and Lightroom.
  • Strong understanding of camera operations, composition, lighting, audio, and videography techniques.
  • Experience with video editing, photo retouching, and post-production.
  • Experience developing storyboards, shot lists, scripts, or other pre-production materials.
  • Comfortable conducting interviews and directing talent in front of the camera.
  • Strong eye for composition, lighting, visual storytelling, and brand presentation.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, particularly when working with homeowners and customers.
  • Highly organized with strong project ownership and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with a broader team.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities and adapting quickly in a field-production environment.
  • Collaborative, feedback-friendly mindset with a passion for pushing creative work beyond the expected.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle required.
  • Ability to travel to project sites and events throughout Improveit’s service territory.

Who We Are

Serving the needs of homeowners since 1989, Improveit! Home Remodeling is a leading replacement contracting company headquartered in Columbus Ohio. Markets served include Columbus, Dayton, Cincinnati, Louisville, Lexington, Southern Indiana, Nashville, and Charlotte. We specialize in replacement windows, bathroom remodeling and kitchen transformations. BBB-Accredited and 24-time Consumers’ Choice Awards Winners, we’ve completed over 60,000 jobs with about one in four of those being repeat customers.

We foster a culture focused on winning and our passion is deeply rooted in continuous improvement. We seek leaders who are interested in developing leaders. For us, “Improveit” is more than a name – it’s an attitude that governs all that we do for our staff, our customers, and our communities.

We value curiosity, passion, continuous improvement, and the relentless pursuit of excellence.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer
Automation / Manufacturing Engineering
DepartmentAutomation / Manufacturing Engineering
Reports ToEngineering Manager
Employment TypeFull-Time, Exempt / Salaried
Position Summary
The Controls Engineer leads the design, programming, integration, and continuous improvement of automation and controls systems across the facility. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle of automation on equipment including welding cells, laser and plasma cutting systems, CNC saws, CNC brake presses, powder coating lines, and assembly operations. The Controls Engineer works directly with industrial and collaborative robots and controls hardware from all major PLC and automation vendors, driving standardization, uptime, and safety across the plant floor.
Key Responsibilities
Controls & Robot Programming
  • Design, program, and commission PLC, HMI, and robot control systems for new and existing production equipment.
  • Lead integration of industrial robots and collaborative robots (cobots) into manufacturing cells, including end-of-arm tooling coordination, safety zoning, and cycle-time optimization.
  • Program, troubleshoot, and maintain controls across welding machines, laser/plasma cutting systems, CNC saws, CNC brake presses, powder coating equipment, and automated/manual assembly stations.
  • PLC logic, HMI screens, and robot programs across major platforms (e.g., Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Fanuc, ABB, Universal Robots, KUKA).
Systems Design & Safety
  • Design and specify control panels, I/O architecture, safety circuits, and networking (Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, DeviceNet, etc.) for new installations and retrofits.
  • Perform risk assessments and ensure controls and robotic systems comply with applicable safety standards (e.g., ISO 10218-1/2, ISO/TS 15066, NFPA 79, CSA Z434, OSHA/CCOHS as applicable).
Troubleshooting & Continuous Improvement
  • Lead root-cause troubleshooting of controls-related downtime; drive corrective and preventive actions.
  • Partner with Continuous Improvement, Maintenance, and Production teams to identify and implement automation opportunities that improve safety, quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Evaluate new automation technologies and vendors to support long-term facility automation strategy.
Project Management & Documentation
  • Manage automation projects from concept through commissioning, including scoping, budgeting, vendor coordination, and documentation.
  • Create and maintain electrical schematics, controls documentation, program backups, and standard work for controls systems.
  • Provide technical mentorship to maintenance technicians and junior engineers on controls and robotics.
Qualifications
Required
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Controls Engineering, or related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in industrial controls engineering within a manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on programming experience with multiple major PLC platforms (e.g., Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Mitsubishi).
  • Experience integrating and programming industrial robots and/or collaborative robots in a production setting.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical control systems, motor controls, drives, sensors, and industrial networking protocols.
  • Working knowledge of robotic and machine safety standards (ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, or equivalent).
  • Experience reading and developing electrical schematics and P&IDs.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to work directly on the plant floor under production pressure.
Preferred
  • Experience with fabrication/metalworking equipment controls: welding, laser/plasma cutting, CNC saws, CNC brake presses, or powder coating lines.
  • Experience with vision systems, robotic weld cells, or CNC machine interfacing (e.g., load/unload automation).
  • Familiarity with SCADA/MES systems and data integration between controls and ERP platforms (e.g., SAP S/4HANA).
  • Experience with safety-rated controllers and functional safety configuration (e.g., safety PLCs, safety-rated robot controllers).
  • Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, or Continuous Improvement certification/experience.
  • Experience managing capital automation projects, including budget and vendor management.
Working Conditions
  • Ability to work on the manufacturing floor around active machinery, welding operations, and material handling equipment.
  • Ability to climb, kneel, and work in confined spaces around machine cells as needed.
  • Use of appropriate PPE required in designated areas (safety glasses, hearing protection, welding shade, etc.).
  • Occasional lifting up to 25–35 lbs.
What We Offer
  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Benefits package – health, dental, vision, retirement matching
  • Opportunity to lead automation strategy at a growing manufacturing facility
  • Exposure to a wide range of equipment and controls technologies across a full production floor

The Coats Company is an equal opportunity employer that evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), age, marital status, disability, veteran status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, and other characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior RHEL Satellite Engineer Lead
description:
Senior RHEL Satellite Engineer / Team Lead - Vancouver, WA

About Trilogy Innovations

At Trilogy Innovations, we are committed to driving meaningful change for our customers and communities through smart, innovative technology that solves real problems. As a growing systems and software engineering company, we partner across public and private sectors to modernize enterprise systems, strengthen security, and deliver high value solutions. Who you are

Trilogy Innovations, Inc. is seeking a Senior RHEL Satellite Engineer to serve as Team Lead on a federal infrastructure modernization engagement supporting a critical U.S. Department of Energy mission environment. This role serves as the single point of technical accountability for delivery quality, architecture decisions, and client engagement throughout the period of performance.

The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of enterprise Linux engineering experience with deep, hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux administration and architecture, Red Hat Satellite design and Day-2 operations, and Ansible Automation Platform. You will lead a lean, high-impact team through a six-milestone RHEL replatforming and Satellite implementation effort in a NERC CIP-governed environment, owning the technical approach from initial assessment through knowledge transfer.

What you will do:

  • Lead Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 8.x, 9.x, and 10.x upgrade initiatives, including troubleshooting, migration planning, risk mitigation, and implementation of greenfield deployment strategies.
  • Design, implement, and maintain Red Hat Satellite 6.x architecture, including Capsule Server placement, content lifecycle management, patch management, and system provisioning strategies.
  • Provide technical leadership for enterprise Linux infrastructure modernization efforts, ensuring solutions align with security, scalability, performance, and operational requirements.
  • Conduct technical reviews and quality assurance of Ansible automation, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and related engineering artifacts to ensure adherence to coding standards, best practices, and project requirements.
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government stakeholders, program leadership, and the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR), providing technical guidance, status updates, and recommendations.
  • Mentor and support junior engineers by promoting best practices, reviewing technical solutions, and developing reusable automation frameworks and engineering patterns.
  • Develop, standardize, and maintain reusable automation solutions to improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability across enterprise environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify technical challenges, develop solutions, and drive successful project execution.
  • Produce, maintain, and deliver technical documentation, including design documents, implementation plans, operational procedures, and project deliverables aligned with Statement of Work (SOW) requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to enhance automation, infrastructure management, operational processes, and service delivery.

How success is measured:

Success is defined by delivering a secure, scalable RHEL platform while leading the team to meet program milestones.

You will be successful if you:

  • Deliver target-state architecture aligned to program and compliance requirements
  • Lead technical execution across all milestones (M1–M6)
  • Ensure successful deployment and operation of OpenShift and Red Hat platforms
  • Establish strong engineering and automation standards
  • Mentor the team and drive high performance
  • Identify and mitigate risks while communicating effectively with stakeholders

What you bring
We require:
  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field. Equivalent professional experience may substitute on a year-for-year basis.
  • Minimum 10+ years of progressive Linux / RHEL engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a technical lead, principal engineer, or architect capacity.
  • Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) certification
  • Red Hat Satellite Specialist credential
  • Demonstrated experience deploying Satellite in disconnected or semi-disconnected federal environments
  • Experience operating under compliance frameworks such as NERC CIP, FISMA, or equivalent
  • Ability to obtain a DOE Security Badge and successfully adjudicate an NBIS eApp background investigation prior to start.

Nice to have
  • Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA)
  • Existing DOE badge or active federal clearance (Public Trust, Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI).

Work environment: Work under this contract is performed approximately 90 percent remotely with on-site support at BPA's Ross Complex / Dittmer Control Center in Vancouver, Washington, not to exceed five business days per month per individual. To ensure responsive on-site presence, minimize travel-day overhead, and provide Pacific Time zone overlap with BPA operations, Trilogy is positioning a technical resource in the Vancouver, Washington / Portland, Oregon metropolitan area for the duration of the contract.


Compensation and Benefits:

Salary range: $175,000 - $180,000

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Performance bonus eligibility
  • 401k with company match
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health Savings Account

Why Trilogy Innovations

At Trilogy Innovations, we believe strong teams build meaningful solutions. We deliver high quality systems and software engineering services across public and private sectors, supporting complex and mission critical environments with integrity, collaboration, and care.

Since 2010, our talented team has partnered with organizations such as the FBI, U.S. Air Force, NASA, Department of Education, Department of Energy, DHS, SOCOM, and leading private sector clients. We are known for combining technical excellence with a thoughtful, people first approach.

At Trilogy, you will work alongside smart, committed professionals in a supportive, learning oriented environment. We value innovation, accountability, and continuous growth, and we encourage our people to bring both expertise and humanity to the work they do.

If you are looking to contribute to impactful work while growing your skills in a collaborative and forward-thinking organization, Trilogy Innovations is a place where you can do just that.

description:

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Senior Network Engineer

Position Summary

The Senior Network Engineer designs, secures, operates, and improves the company’s enterprise network infrastructure across distributed offices, on-premises systems, and cloud environments. This hands-on role owns network architecture, availability, performance, security, documentation, and lifecycle management.

The position will lead the standardization and modernization of Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, Zscaler, and Microsoft Azure networking while serving as the senior escalation point for complex network incidents. Success requires strong technical ownership, effective cross-functional collaboration, and a focus on delivering secure, resilient, and consistent connectivity across the enterprise.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Network Engineering and Administration

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, VPN, Internet-edge, and cloud network services.
  • Configure and optimize enterprise switching, including VLANs, trunks, Spanning Tree Protocol, link aggregation, port security, Quality of Service, and resilient uplinks.
  • Administer Fortinet firewalls, including routing, NAT, security policies, VPNs, logging, high availability, and configuration standards.
  • Design and support Cisco Meraki switching and wireless networks, including standardized SSIDs, RF settings, roaming, and WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise authentication.
  • Implement and maintain Zscaler-based secure connectivity, network segmentation, identity-aware access policies, and zero-trust networking principles.
  • Design resilient connectivity between company locations, on-premises infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and other cloud services, including site-to-site VPNs and ISP failover.

Operations, Security, and Reliability

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex network, firewall, wireless, VPN, ISP, DNS, DHCP, and cloud-connectivity incidents.
  • Troubleshoot issues using packet captures, traffic analysis, logs, routing data, wireless metrics, and structured root-cause analysis.
  • Deploy and maintain network monitoring, scanning, discovery, configuration-management, and performance-analysis capabilities.
  • Plan and execute network upgrades, hardware refreshes, migrations, maintenance, and cutovers using documented testing and rollback procedures.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity to remediate vulnerabilities, obsolete configurations, excessive access, unsupported firmware, and unnecessary firewall rules.

Documentation and Leadership

  • Maintain network diagrams, enterprise topologies, IP address management, VLAN records, port maps, circuit inventories, firewall rules, VPN documentation, and configuration standards.
  • Manage incidents, problems, and changes through Jira and Jira Service Management, and maintain technical standards and procedures in Confluence.
  • Lead technical design reviews, coordinate vendors and carriers, mentor technical staff, and identify opportunities to improve resilience, standardization, and automation.

Required Qualifications

  • Must qualify as a U.S. Person under applicable U.S. export-control laws and regulations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, and experience.
  • At least 8 years of progressive enterprise network engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a senior, lead, or Tier 3 engineering role.
  • Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, trunking, Spanning Tree Protocol, link aggregation, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, and network segmentation.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Fortinet firewalls, Cisco Meraki switching and wireless infrastructure, enterprise Wi-Fi, RF troubleshooting, and 802.1X authentication.
  • Experience implementing Azure hybrid connectivity, site-to-site VPNs, redundant ISP services, and Zscaler or a comparable SASE or zero-trust platform.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex network issues, maintain accurate technical documentation, and support Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
  • Experience leading network projects and changes, managing critical incidents, and communicating technical risks and recommendations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Desired Additional Qualifications

  • Cisco CCNP, Cisco Meraki, Fortinet, Zscaler, or Microsoft Azure networking certification.
  • Experience with advanced Azure networking, AWS networking, ExpressRoute, Virtual WAN, Transit Gateway, or Direct Connect.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft GCC High, Microsoft Commercial, or environments governed by CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, or ITAR requirements.
  • Familiarity with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, RADIUS, Microsoft NPS, Cisco ISE, certificate-based authentication, and network access control.
  • Experience automating network administration using Python, PowerShell, or APIs.
  • Experience with FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, SolarWinds, PRTG, LogicMonitor, NetBox, Infoblox, or comparable monitoring and IP address management platforms.

title: Clinical Supervisor (LCSW/CASAC)
description:
Join Mindify Wellness and Care

Mindify Wellness and Care is a growing behavioral health organization committed to providing compassionate, culturally responsive, and accessible mental health services to individuals and families throughout New York.

Through a flexible care model that combines telehealth, outpatient therapy, psychiatric services, and community-based partnerships across New York, we are expanding access to high-quality behavioral healthcare while building a strong, supportive clinical team.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Clinical Supervisor who holds both an active New York LCSW and CASAC to provide clinical leadership, ensure quality, maintain compliance, and support the development of a multidisciplinary team of behavioral health professionals.

Because this position provides supervision to clinicians pursuing multiple licensure and credentialing pathways, candidates must possess the credentials necessary to supervise social work, counseling, and substance use disorder professionals. An active New York LCSW and CASAC are required.

Growth Opportunity

This position is designed to start on a part-time basis and transition into a full-time leadership role as the organization continues to expand.

We are seeking a supervisor who is excited to grow alongside the organization and play a key role in shaping clinical operations, quality initiatives, staff development, and future program growth.

As Mindify scales its services and clinical team, this role is expected to increase in scope and responsibility, offering meaningful opportunities for advancement into senior clinical leadership positions.

Position Overview

The Clinical Supervisor serves as a key clinical leader within the organization, providing supervision, mentorship, quality oversight, and operational support to a multidisciplinary team that may include:

  • LMSWs
  • LCSWs
  • LMHCs
  • MHC-LPs
  • LMFTs
  • CASAC Trainees
  • CASACs
  • Psychotherapists
  • Behavioral Health Interns
  • Other Behavioral Health Professionals

The ideal candidate is both a skilled clinician and an effective leader, capable of driving clinical excellence, maintaining regulatory compliance, improving clinician performance, and helping build the systems, processes, and infrastructure necessary to support organizational growth.

This is a primarily remote position. Most responsibilities may be performed virtually; however, periodic onsite attendance within New York State will be required for training, supervision activities, quality initiatives, staff meetings, onboarding, program development, and other operational needs.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Supervision and Team Leadership

  • Conduct individual and group supervision in accordance with New York licensing, credentialing, and professional practice requirements.
  • Provide clinical consultation, mentorship, and leadership to licensed and pre-licensed clinicians.
  • Support clinicians in developing clinical skills, treatment planning, diagnostic formulation, and evidence-based interventions.
  • Facilitate regular supervision sessions and maintain required supervision documentation.
  • Hold clinical department meetings and case consultation meetings.
  • Coach clinicians on documentation standards, productivity expectations, ethical decision-making, patient engagement, and professional development.
  • Provide support regarding crisis intervention, risk assessment, mandated reporting, and clinical decision-making.
  • Assist in the development of clinical policies, procedures, and best practices.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and supportive clinical culture.

Documentation Compliance

  • Monitor clinician documentation for quality, accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
  • Ensure treatment plans, assessments, progress notes, discharge summaries, and related records meet organizational, payer, and regulatory standards.
  • Work toward organizational goals related to documentation completion and compliance.
  • Address documentation deficiencies through coaching, training, and corrective action when appropriate.
  • Track and follow up on overdue documentation.
  • Identify trends requiring workflow improvements or additional staff education.

Therapist Productivity and Caseload Management

  • Monitor clinician caseloads, productivity, and schedule utilization.
  • Support clinicians in maintaining healthy and sustainable caseloads.
  • Collaborate with administrative and operations teams to improve appointment availability and patient access.
  • Assist in managing clinician schedules, coverage plans, and workflow efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to improve patient retention, engagement, and continuity of care.

Quality Assurance and Clinical Oversight

  • Conduct routine chart audits and document findings.
  • Review assessments, diagnoses, treatment plans, and clinical documentation for quality and compliance.
  • Monitor adherence to evidence-based practices and clinical standards.
  • Develop corrective action plans and monitor improvement initiatives as needed.
  • Identify quality trends and recommend process improvements.
  • Assist with preparation for audits, accreditation reviews, and compliance activities.

Compliance and Credentialing

  • Monitor professional licenses, certifications, supervision eligibility, and renewal requirements.
  • Ensure clinicians complete required trainings and competency assessments.
  • Promote compliance with HIPAA, payer requirements, professional ethics, company policies, and New York regulations.
  • Support credentialing, recredentialing, and compliance monitoring processes.
  • Maintain readiness for internal reviews, audits, and regulatory inquiries.

Recruitment, Onboarding, and Staff Development

  • Participate in candidate screening, interviewing, and hiring processes.
  • Assist with onboarding and orientation of new clinicians.
  • Support clinician training and professional development initiatives.
  • Evaluate clinician competencies and identify training needs.
  • Mentor developing clinicians and support career growth opportunities.
  • Help build and retain a high-performing clinical team.

Scheduling and Coverage

  • Coordinate clinician coverage and staffing needs.
  • Assist with schedule modifications, PTO requests, and coverage planning.
  • Minimize disruptions to patient care caused by staffing gaps.
  • Collaborate with leadership to address service demand and workforce planning needs.

Operational Collaboration

  • Work closely with executive leadership, psychiatric providers, therapists, and administrative staff.
  • Provide recommendations regarding clinical operations, service delivery models, and program development.
  • Contribute to organizational growth initiatives and new service-line development.
  • Support expansion efforts across New York as the organization continues to grow.

Required Qualifications

Required Licensure and Credentials

Candidates must possess all of the following:

  • Active, unrestricted New York Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) license in good standing.
  • Active New York Credentialed Alcoholism and Substance Abuse Counselor (CASAC) credential in good standing.
  • Eligibility to supervise behavioral health professionals under applicable New York regulations.
  • Clinical supervision training and qualifications consistent with New York requirements.

Education

  • Master's Degree or higher in Social Work from an accredited institution.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum of three years of post-LCSW clinical experience.
  • Previous clinical supervision experience.
  • Behavioral health leadership or management experience preferred.
  • Experience supervising multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of clinical documentation, treatment planning, risk management, utilization management, compliance, and quality assurance.
  • Experience conducting chart audits and providing performance coaching.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working within a growing and evolving organization.
  • Ability to attend periodic onsite meetings and organizational activities throughout New York State.

Why LCSW and CASAC Are Required

This position provides supervision and clinical oversight to professionals working toward a variety of behavioral health licenses and credentials. To support Mindify's multidisciplinary clinical model, the Clinical Supervisor must possess the qualifications necessary to supervise both mental health and substance use disorder professionals and provide oversight across a broad range of provider types.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional advanced behavioral health licenses or certifications.
  • Experience supervising social workers, counselors, and substance use treatment professionals.
  • Experience in outpatient mental health, telehealth, psychiatry, community-based care, substance use treatment, or integrated behavioral health settings.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Experience with payer audits, utilization management, credentialing, and compliance programs.
  • Experience recruiting, onboarding, and managing clinician performance.
  • Bilingual or multilingual proficiency strongly preferred.
  • Experience serving culturally diverse populations.

Schedule and Work Arrangement

  • Position will initially begin on a part-time basis, with the expectation of transitioning into a full-time leadership role based on organizational growth and performance.
  • Primarily remote position.
  • Periodic onsite attendance throughout New York State required for meetings, training, supervision, quality initiatives, onboarding, and operational activities.
  • Flexible scheduling available.
  • Supervisor must remain available during agreed-upon operating hours and for urgent clinical consultation when necessary.
  • Opportunity for expanded leadership responsibilities as the organization continues to grow.

Compensation

Part-Time (Initial Phase)

$45-60 per hour

Full-Time (Upon Transition)

$80,000-100,000

Final compensation will be based on clinical experience, supervisory experience, leadership background, substance use treatment expertise, bilingual capabilities, additional certifications, and the number and type of clinicians supervised.

As Mindify continues to grow, this position is expected to evolve from a part-time supervisory role into a full-time leadership opportunity with increased responsibility, organizational influence, and advancement potential.

Benefits and Growth

Eligible employees may receive:

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Flexible hybrid and remote work opportunities
  • Leadership development and professional growth opportunities
  • Continuing education support
  • Clinical and administrative support resources
  • Opportunities for advancement within a growing behavioral health organization
  • The opportunity to help shape clinical systems, culture, and programs as Mindify expands throughout New York

Mindify is actively expanding its employee benefits package and organizational infrastructure. Additional benefits and professional development opportunities may become available as the organization continues to scale.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Mindify Wellness and Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and supported.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Director of Managed Care and Contracting (53989)
description:

At Performance Home Medical (PHM), our patients come first. We use the latest technology with compassionate clinical support to empower individuals in managing their conditions, helping them live longer, healthier, and more independent lives.

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and results-driven Director of Managed Care and Contracting to lead and optimize our payer strategy and provider agreements. This key leadership role is responsible for developing, negotiating, and managing managed care contracts that align with our organization’s financial goals and patient care priorities. The ideal candidate will bring leadership qualities that resonate with the collaborative and mission-driven culture at Performance Home Medical, a leading provider of medical supplies.

This remote position provides support across our markets in Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and Texas.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Director of Managed Care and Contracting is a senior leadership role responsible for developing, negotiating, and managing payor relationships and contracts across the organization’s service markets. This individual plays a pivotal role in ensuring patients receive uninterrupted access to high-quality care during periods of organizational change and growth, serving as a trusted liaison between the company and its managed care partners.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned managed care professional who brings deep knowledge of payor reimbursement structures, a collaborative spirit, and the drive to build lasting relationships with payers, patients, and internal stakeholders alike.

KEY RESPONSABILITIES:

Contracting & Payor Relations

  • Lead the negotiation, execution, and management of managed care contracts with commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and other third-party payors.
  • Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with payor representatives to ensure favorable contract terms and continuity of care.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for payor escalations, audits, and contract renewals.
  • Monitor contract performance, reimbursement trends, and payor policy changes to proactively address risks and opportunities.

title: Project Manager - HVAC Controls
description:
The Project Manager leads and supervises all aspects of assigned projects within the solutions business, including new construction, renovations, upgrades, tenant improvements, and service upgrades. The Project Manager works collaboratively with internal teams, clients, subcontractors, vendors, and stakeholders to deliver projects on time and within scope. This position supports NY/NJ area.

Essential Functions: An individual must be able to successfully perform the essential functions of this position with or without a reasonable accommodation.

Project Management:

  • Lead and manage project coordination efforts, including contract review, procurement, scheduling, and resource allocation, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to client expectations.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, manage internal and external stakeholders, and act as the key point of contact for subcontractors, clients, and internal teams.

  • Negotiate contracts and manage change orders, scheduling, and coordination to ensure resources are aligned with project timelines and goals.
  • Provide ongoing support to subcontractors, helping them understand and meet project expectations, safety guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Foster effective relationships with subcontractors to ensure smooth execution and project success.

Billings and Financials:

  • Prepare and manage monthly project revenue and expense reports, ensuring adherence to the Schedule of Values (SOV) and AIA billing processes.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Prepare detailed project status reports for Senior Project Managers, Project Executives, and Operations Managers, ensuring timely and accurate information on project progress.

Change Order Management:

  • Identify, estimate, and pursue change order opportunities, ensuring accurate documentation and coordination.
  • Oversee the negotiation and approval process with customers, ensuring that all changes are properly tracked and integrated into the project’s financials.
  • Maintain up-to-date records on all change orders, ensuring that their impacts on project scope, schedule, and budget are clearly understood and communicated.

Procurement and Inventory Support:

  • Specify, order, and track project materials to ensure that all necessary items are available when needed for installation and commissioning.
  • Maintain company tools, equipment, and materials, ensuring that items are in good condition and accessible for project use.
  • Collaborate with project teams to adjust procurement schedules and material orders based on project timelines and unforeseen changes.

Risk and Issue Management:

  • Identify, assess, and monitor project risks and issues throughout the project lifecycle. Develop and implement mitigation strategies to minimize their impact on project success.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for resolving operational or technical challenges, working closely with stakeholders to identify solutions.
  • Escalate complex risks and disputes as needed while maintaining alignment with client and project objectives.

Project Delivery, Quality Assurance & Handover:

  • Implement quality assurance processes, monitor compliance, and take corrective actions.
  • Oversee project startup, installation, commissioning, and ensure systems meet specifications.
  • Coordinate final turnover documentation, including design documents, system backups, and training.

Compliance and Standards:

  • Actively contribute to a safe work environment by identifying, mitigating, and addressing risks.
  • Lead initial investigations of safety incidents or accidents and develop corrective action strategies to prevent future occurrences.
  • Emphasize safety as a shared responsibility, integrating it into daily project activities and team culture.

Client and Stakeholder Relations:

  • Serve as the central point of contact for clients, consultants, and contractors.
  • Provide regular project updates, status reports, and problem resolution to maintain client confidence and satisfaction.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations by ensuring alignment between project deliverables, timelines, and resource plans.

Collaboration:

  • Foster collaboration across divisions and internal departments such as engineering, service, and sales to ensure seamless project execution.
  • Facilitate cross-functional meetings to align objectives, share resources, and leverage expertise across teams, enhancing project efficiency and outcomes.
  • Proactively resolve team interdependencies to prevent project delays.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead by example in maintaining proficiency and sharing industry insights to enhance team performance and development.

title: Audionom till hörselvården
description:
Öron-, näs- och halskliniken är en länsklinik inom Sinnescentrum, Region Östergötland som svarar för all sjukvård i regionen inom öron-, näs- och halsspecialiteten. Som universitetsklinik har vi tre huvuduppdrag; att bedriva specialiserad vård, undervisa samt bedriva forskning och utveckling. Region Östergötland består av tre hörselvårdskliniker med cirka 60 anställda, där vi nu söker en kollega till vårt team i Norrköping på Vrinnevisjukhuset!

Vårt erbjudande

För livet framåt. Region Östergötland har höga ambitioner och ett ansvarsfullt uppdrag. Det handlar om hälsa och vård, om vår regions utveckling och om dem som lever och vistas här. Vi vill fortsätta att vara i framkant, med vård, forskning och utbildning. Det handlar om att våga tänka nytt – och att ha de bästa medarbetarna. Därför erbjuder vi unika möjligheter till vidare lärande och satsar på moderna miljöer med effektiva system och verktyg. Många av oss möter patienter och närstående, andra skapar förutsättningarna för livsviktiga insatser. Hos oss jobbar fantastiska människor mot samma mål – att göra skillnad på riktigt, och för livet framåt.

Läs gärna om dina förmåner hos oss.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vi söker dig som vill ha en bred och varierad utmaning i din yrkesroll som audionom. Hos oss kan du få arbeta med hela vårdkedjan – från diagnostik till rehabilitering och habilitering.

Arbetsuppgifterna kan bland annat innefatta:

  • objektiva och psykoakustiska mätmetoder.

  • stöd och uppföljning av patienter med hörselnedsättning.

  • fördjupad rehabiliterande insatser inom hörselvården.

I vårt uppdrag ingår även att bedriva vård på vårdcentraler runt om i regionen för att öka tillgängligheten för patienterna. Därför är det meriterande med B-körkort.

Som ny hos oss arbetar du tillsammans med flera olika yrkeskategorier med varierande erfarenhet. Vi erbjuder goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll som audionom och beroende på intresse finns möjlighet till vidareutbildning och subspecialisering. Specialisering kan exempelvis vara barnhabilitering, tinnitusrehabilitering eller balansmätningar.

Hos oss möts du av trevliga och engagerade kollegor. Du får en trygg introduktion på din nya arbetsplats och blir snabbt en del av gemenskapen i teamet.

Arbetsgrupp

På Vrinnevisjukhuset arbetar idag sex audionomer i en dynamisk och kunnig verksamhet. Du blir en del av ett tvärprofessionellt team i olika professioner, där många samarbetar regionöver-gripande. Tillsammans skapar vi en bred kompetens, ett stimulerande arbetsklimat och goda möjligheter till erfarenhetsutbyte och utveckling.

Delar av verksamheten har nyligen flyttat in i splitternya, moderna lokaler med en genomtänkt arbetsmiljö som skapar goda förutsättningar för både fokus och samarbete.

Om dig

Du är legitimerad audionom, gärna med erfarenhet av yrket. Praktisk erfarenhet som audionom är meriterande, liksom tidigare arbete inom patientnära vård.

Vi söker dig som har god kommunikativ förmåga, är flexibel och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i team. Du har ett gott och professionellt bemötande, arbetar personcentrerat och sätter alltid patientens behov i fokus.

Som person är du strukturerad, ansvarstagande och har god förmåga att organisera och prioritera ditt arbete för att bidra till ett effektivt patientflöde och hög vårdkvalitet. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper, samarbetsförmåga och social kompetens.

Ansökan och anställning

Inför anställning i ett patientnära arbete inom Region Östergötland kommer du att få fylla i en hälsodeklaration.

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan! Om du behöver hjälp med att registrera i systemet, kontakta kundtjänst Stöd och service, 010-103 60 00, under kontorstid.

Till bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra externa aktörer och försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Region Östergötland har upphandlade avtal.

title: Senior Editor

What you can do matters more to us than what you've done previously. We value an open mind, a drive to succeed, and good old-fashioned hard work over a laundry list of credentials. If you think you have what it takes but don't tick every box, we absolutely encourage you to apply. We'd love to meet the real you and see what else is in your toolbox.


Our Qualifications and Experience Wishlist
  • Bachelor's degree in media, production, advertising, communications, or marketing (preferred).
  • 3+ years of industry-relevant experience.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, with strong editing, motion, and design skills.

  • Experience with 3D software, such as Unreal Engine or Blender, would be highly advantageous.
  • Exemplary organisational skills and attention to detail.

Our Benefits

  • 4 weeks’ annual vacation, 8 personal/sick days, loyalty days, birthday off, summer days, parental leave, & more!

title: Tabletop Game Designer
description:
Goliath is an international manufacturer and distributor of toys and games, operating in 15 countries and reaching over 100 countries worldwide. At the heart of our business is a belief in great products and the magic of innovation. Our mission is to bring fun to every household, which we achieve through teamwork and clever collaboration.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly creative, resourceful, and organized Game Designer to invent and develop innovative tabletop games across a wide range of categories, including preschool, kids, family, party, crime and mystery, light strategy, and licensed games.

The Game Designer will turn early-stage ideas into engaging, intuitive, and commercially viable games. This person will own concepts through iterative development—creating prototypes, testing gameplay, refining mechanics, writing rules, and collaborating with internal teams and external creative partners.

The ideal candidate combines imaginative thinking with disciplined execution. They can take a loose idea and transform it into a compelling game experience with minimal supervision, while working quickly, managing multiple projects, and responding to changing priorities and stakeholder feedback.

Key Responsibilities

· Invent and develop original games across multiple categories using ideas from internal teams, inventors, licensors, external partners, consumer insights, and emerging trends.

· Turn early-stage ideas into engaging, accessible, and commercially viable prototypes.

· Manage multiple projects from concept through weekly iteration, documentation, final development, and production handoff.

· Plan and facilitate playtesting with internal teams and target consumers, translating feedback and observed behavior into actionable improvements.

· Write clear, engaging, audience-appropriate instructions and develop instruction-manual layouts informed by consumer testing.

· Present concepts, prototypes, playtest findings, and recommendations; incorporate stakeholder feedback while protecting the integrity of the game experience.

· Develop gameplay talking points and confidently demonstrate games for internal teams, licensors, and other partners.

· Plan and lead structured team brainstorms, providing creative direction and documentation to move the strongest ideas into development.

· Research social, cultural, entertainment, toy, and gaming trends; evaluate current, historical, and competitive games to identify innovations and market opportunities.

· Attend trade shows, conventions, inventor events, and industry gatherings to find inspiration, research products, and identify potential inventors and partners.

· Maintain a strong working knowledge of current and historical board games, gameplay mechanics, formats, materials, components, and construction innovations.

Requirements

Professional experience in board game development, game design, product development, toy development, or a closely related creative field.

· Demonstrated ability to develop a game from an early-stage idea through prototyping, playtesting, iteration, and final documentation.

· Strong understanding of gameplay mechanics, player psychology, pacing, balance, accessibility, and age-appropriate design.

· Excellent writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain gameplay clearly and concisely.

· Experience planning, conducting, and documenting structured playtests.

· Ability to turn qualitative consumer observations into specific, actionable improvements.

· Excellent organizational and project-management abilities, including the capacity to manage several projects with shifting timelines and priorities.

· Ability to work autonomously, exercise sound judgment, and move projects forward with minimal supervision.

· Comfortable giving, receiving, evaluating, and incorporating constructive feedback.

· A portfolio of published games, prototypes, instructions, or other relevant game-development work.

Benefits

  • 401(k) with company matching
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance to keep you covered
  • Life insurance
  • Flexible spending and health savings accounts to manage your healthcare costs
  • Paid time off to recharge when you need it
  • Join a fun, dynamic and creative industry—working with toys and games brings its own rewards

title: E-Commerce Coordinator
description:
About SuperOrdinary:

At SuperOrdinary, we're the driving force behind the global success of today's most exciting consumer brands. More than an agency, we'rethe go-to growth partner for brands looking to win in social commerce, connecting industry leaders like Disney, H&M, Laneige, Touchland, Glow Recipe, and Peter Thomas Roth with creators and consumers around the world. Our team of e-commerce, creator, and social commerce experts helps brands build influence, accelerate sales, and create meaningful consumer connections across the world's fastest-growing marketplaces.

We're at the forefront of the social commerce revolution, pioneering growth on TikTok Shop and other emerging platforms where content, community, and commerce come together. The playbook is constantly evolving, and so are we. We thrive in an environment where experimentation, speed, and continuous learning are essential to staying ahead.

We're looking for people who are naturally curious, solutions-oriented, and energized by solving complex challenges. The best teammates here have a hustle mentality, embrace change, and are always looking for better ways to build, test, and scale. We set a high bar for ourselves and for our partners, earning our reputation as the trusted experts brands rely on to navigate an ever-changing landscape and deliver exceptional results.

Ecommerce Coordinator

Role Overview

The Ecommerce Coordinator supports the Ecommerce Manager and Brand Success team in the day-to-day management and execution of ecommerce operations across platforms such as TikTok Shop and Amazon.

This role is focused on ensuring ecommerce accounts remain operational, organized, and customer-ready. The Ecommerce Coordinator will assist with order monitoring, customer experience, account health, integrations, reviews, fulfillment issues, and reporting while escalating more complex issues to the Ecommerce Manager.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple tasks across ecommerce platforms. TikTok Shop and FBT experience is strongly preferred, while Amazon Seller Central and FBA experience are a plus. This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is comfortable wearing multiple hats and supporting the team wherever needed.

Key Responsibilities

Ecommerce Operations

  • Support day-to-day ecommerce operations across TikTok Shop and Shopify.

  • Monitor storefronts, product listings, inventory, pricing, promotions, and account settings for accuracy.

  • Assist with ecommerce account audits and identify issues that require attention.

  • Maintain accurate trackers, documentation, and operational records.

  • Escalate issues and risks to the Ecommerce Manager and Brand team.

Customer Experience

  • Monitor and assist with customer messages across ecommerce platforms.

  • Support customer service teams and VAs with customer escalations.

  • Monitor customer experience issues and identify recurring concerns.

  • Assist with resolving order-related customer issues in coordination with the appropriate teams.

Orders, Returns & Refunds

  • Monitor orders for delays, cancellations, fulfillment issues, and other exceptions.

  • Flag overdue or problematic orders and escalate them to the appropriate teams.

  • Track unresolved customer and order issues through completion.

  • Identify recurring order or fulfillment issues and communicate trends to the Ecommerce Manager.

Reviews & Customer Feedback

  • Flag negative or concerning reviews for appropriate follow-up.

  • Track recurring product, fulfillment, or customer experience feedback.

  • Escalate potential product or account issues to the Ecommerce Manager and Brand Success team.

Account Health & Shop Performance

  • Monitor TikTok Shop account health, shop violations, warnings, and other platform notifications.

  • Monitor Seller Performance Score (SPS) and flag changes or areas of concern.

  • Assist with gathering information and documentation needed for violation appeals or rectifications.

  • Monitor marketplace requirements and escalate potential compliance issues.

  • Support regular account audits and performance checks.

Integrations & Fulfillment

  • Monitor ecommerce integrations for order, inventory, and product synchronization issues.

  • Assist with troubleshooting Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, FBA, FBT, and other ecommerce integrations.

  • Monitor fulfillment-related issues, including inventory discrepancies, shipment delays, tracking issues, and inbound problems.

  • Escalate technical or fulfillment issues to the Ecommerce Manager or appropriate internal/external team.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain ecommerce trackers, reports, and team documentation.

  • Assist with weekly and monthly reporting as needed.

  • Gather data related to orders, customer service, reviews, violations, SPS, fulfillment, and account performance.

  • Keep account information and action items organized and up to date.

  • Help document recurring issues and solutions.

SOPs & Process Support

  • Follow established SOPs and workflows for ecommerce operations.

  • Assist with creating and updating SOPs, tutorials, checklists, and training materials.

  • Identify opportunities to improve existing processes and communicate recommendations to the Ecommerce Manager.

  • Help ensure VAs and support teams are following established processes correctly.

Team & Cross-Functional Support

  • Work under the direction of the Ecommerce Manager and in partnership with the Brand Success team.

  • Support Brand Success Managers with ecommerce-related tasks and follow-ups.

  • Coordinate with Customer Service, Operations, Logistics, Fulfillment, and other internal teams as needed.

  • Complete assigned tasks and follow up on outstanding action items.

  • Be willing to support different areas of the ecommerce operation based on business needs.

Qualifications

  • 1-3+ years of experience in ecommerce, marketplace operations, customer service, digital commerce, or a related field.

  • TikTok Shop/Seller Center experience strongly preferred.

  • Amazon Seller Central and FBA experience is a plus.

  • Experience with FBT or other third-party fulfillment programs is a plus.

  • Experience with ecommerce customer service, order management, returns, refunds, or reviews preferred.

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, and ecommerce platforms.

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to identify issues and escalate them appropriately.

  • Comfortable learning new platforms, tools, and processes.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Proactive, dependable, and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and wearing multiple hats.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who can be the day-to-day operational support for the Ecommerce Manager and Brand Success team.

The Ecommerce Coordinator does not need to be the primary decision-maker for the ecommerce accounts. Instead, they should be able to monitor, execute, identify, document, and escalate effectively.

A successful Ecommerce Coordinator will be someone who notices that an order is overdue, an integration is not syncing, SPS has dropped, a shop violation has appeared, a customer issue is unresolved, or negative reviews are increasing—and knows how to either resolve the issue using an existing process or escalate it to the right person.

The role is ideal for someone looking to build a strong foundation in TikTok Shop, Amazon, ecommerce operations, customer experience, fulfillment, and marketplace management while working closely with an Ecommerce Manager and Brand Success team.

What We Offer:

  • Career Growth: Join a rapidly growing business with significant opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

  • Competitive Compensation: Earn a competitive base salary (depending on experience and skill set), plus eligibility for a performance-based annual bonus

  • Time Off & Flexibility: Take advantage of Flexible PTO, paid holidays, and paid sick leave to support a healthy work-life balance

  • Retirement Benefits: Plan for the future with a 401(k) retirement savings program

  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Access competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family.

  • Hybrid Work Schedule: Enjoy a collaborative 4-day in-office schedule (West Hollywood, CA) with 1 remote workday each week.

  • Team Perks: Stay fueled with weekly catered team lunches plus a meal stipend provided twice per week.
